description: Lists what needs a person on a repository, as the dashboard's Needs you panel does and in its order, most urgent first: the main branch failing CI, failing pull requests nobody is on, work held by a session that has ended, green or approved pull requests left unmerged, pull requests waiting long for review, claims that have gone quiet, two pieces of work changing the same files, issues closed without shipping, and phases out of step with their pull request. Each item has its kind, how serious it is, the issue or pull request it is about (number, title, link) and a one-line reason with what to do. Use it when your human asks what needs attention, or before you pick work, to fix what is blocking others first. The answer says when the dashboard is still reading pull request states, or could not make a check. Read-only, and it never fails: if the list cannot be read it says why.

repo.description: owner/name. Optional when the token covers one repository.
